题解

思路：字符串处理 + 递归

  1. 此题考察字符串处理，以及考察处理嵌套类型时递归的应用。
  2. 编码和解码的情况分别定义一个函数去进行处理。在编码和解码两种情况下对于嵌套类型的处理都可以使用递归去进行处理。
  3. 编码和解码具体逻辑可以参照下面对应代码实现。

python:
from typing import List
​
# 类型长度映射
typeLength = {"0": 7, "1": 6, "2": 7}
# 类型字符串映射
typeToStringMp = {"0": "Integer", "1": "String", "2": "Compose"}
# 标志是否出现格式错误
flag = False
​
​
class Item:
    def __init__(self, pos: str, type_: str, count: int, value: str):
        self.pos = pos  # 位置
        self.type = type_  # 类型
        self.count = count  # 长度
        self.value = value  # 值
        self.children: List[Item] = []  # 子项列表
​
​
def splitTopLevelItem(input_str: str) -> List[str]:
    """最顶层按照括号进行切割"""
    global flag
    res = []
    depth = 0
    start = 0
    n = len(input_str)
    for i, c in enumerate(input_str):
        if c == '[':
            if depth == 0:
                start = i
            depth += 1
        elif c == ']':
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                res.append(input_str[start:i + 1])
        if depth < 0:
            flag = True  # 括号乱序，右括号过多
            break
    if depth != 0:
        flag = True  # 括号不匹配
    return res
​
​
def encode(input_str: str) -> List[Item]:
    """编码"""
    global flag
    res = []
    if not input_str:
        return res
    # 判断格式    
    if input_str[0] != '[' or input_str[-1] != ']':
        flag = True
        return res
​
    ans = splitTopLevelItem(input_str)
    if flag:
        return res
    n = len(ans)
​
    for i in range(n):
        itemStr = ans[i]
        # 去除左右括号
        itemStr = itemStr[1:-1]
        currentAns = []
        tmp = ""
        m = len(itemStr)
        j = 0
        while j < m:
            c = itemStr[j]
            if c != ',':
                tmp += c
            else:
                currentAns.append(tmp)
                tmp = ""
                if len(currentAns) == 2:
                    break
            j += 1
        type_str = currentAns[-1]
        # 根据类型进行不同处理
        if type_str == "Integer" or type_str == "String":
            value = itemStr[j + 1:]
            count = len(value)
            type_code = "0" if currentAns[1] == "Integer" else "1"
            res.append(Item(currentAns[0], type_code, count, value))
        elif type_str == "Compose":
            childrenItemStr = itemStr[j + 1:]
            children = encode(childrenItemStr)
            count = 0
            for item in children:
                count += item.count + typeLength[item.type]
            composeItem = Item(currentAns[0], "2", count, "")
            composeItem.children = children
            res.append(composeItem)
    return res
​
​
def formatEncodePrint(items: List[Item]):
    """递归格式化输出编码结果"""
    for item in items:
        if item.type == "0" or item.type == "1":
            print(f"{item.pos}#{item.type}#{item.count}#{item.value}", end="")
        else:
            print(f"{item.pos}#{item.type}#{item.count}#", end="")
            formatEncodePrint(item.children)
​
​
def formatDecodePrint(items: List[Item]):
    """递归格式化输出解码结果"""
    n = len(items)
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if item.type == "0" or item.type == "1":
            print(f"[{item.pos},{typeToStringMp[item.type]},{item.value}]", end="")
        else:
            print(f"[{item.pos},{typeToStringMp[item.type]},", end="")
            formatDecodePrint(item.children)
            print("]", end="")
        if i != n - 1:
            print(",", end="")
​
​
def split(str_: str, delimiter: str) -> List[str]:
    
    return str_.split(delimiter)
​
​
def getChildrenInput(parts: List[str], index: List[int], count: int) -> str:
    """获取子复合类型的字符串内容"""
    global flag
    pos = ""
    type_ = ""
    value = ""
    subCount = -1
​
    res = ""
    n = len(parts)
    tmpCount = 0
    # 根据长度来切割处理
    while index[0] < n and tmpCount < count:
        if pos == "":
            pos = parts[index[0]]
        elif type_ == "":
            type_ = parts[index[0]]
        elif subCount == -1:
            subCount = int(parts[index[0]])
        else:
            tmpCount += typeLength[type_] + subCount
            if type_ == "0" or type_ == "1":
                value = parts[index[0]]
                if len(value) < subCount:
                    flag = True
                    break
                valuePart = value[:subCount]
                remainngStr = value[subCount:]
                parts[index[0]] = remainngStr
                res += f"{pos}#{type_}#{subCount}#{valuePart}"
                index[0] -= 1  # 退回一步让decode处理
            else:
                res += f"{pos}#{type_}#{subCount}#"
                
                res += getChildrenInput(parts, index, subCount)
                index[0] -= 1
            pos = ""
            type_ = ""
            value = ""
            subCount = -1
        index[0] += 1
​
    if tmpCount != count:
        flag = True
    return res
​
​
def decode(input_str: str) -> List[Item]:
    """解码"""
    global flag
    res = []
    parts = split(input_str, "#")
    m = len(parts)
    pos = ""
    type_ = ""
    value = ""
    count = -1
    i = 0
    while i < m:
        # 按顺序赋值
        if pos == "":
            pos = parts[i]
        elif type_ == "":
            type_ = parts[i]
        elif count == -1:
            count = int(parts[i])
        else:
            if type_ == "0" or type_ == "1":
                value = parts[i]
                if (i != m - 1 and len(value) <= count) or (i == m - 1 and len(value) != count):
                    flag = True
                    break
                remainngStr = value[count:]
                value = value[:count]
                res.append(Item(pos, type_, count, value))
                parts[i] = remainngStr
                i -= 1
            else:
                j = [i]
                childrenInput = getChildrenInput(parts, j, count)
                if flag:
                    break
                res.append(Item(pos, type_, count, ""))
                childrenItem = decode(childrenInput)
                res[-1].children = childrenItem
                i = j[0] - 1
            pos = ""
            type_ = ""
            count = -1
            value = ""
        i += 1
​
    if pos != "" or type_ != "" or count != -1 or value != "":
        flag = True
    return res
​
​
if __name__ == "__main__":
    flag = False
    command = int(input())
    input_str = input()
    if command == 1:
        items = encode(input_str)
        if flag:
            print("ENCODE_ERROR")
        else:
            formatEncodePrint(items)
    elif command == 2:
        items = decode(input_str)
        if flag:
            print("DECODE_ERROR")
        else:
            formatDecodePrint(items)
